name: hba-run
description: Run panel plugin (FR-4): run configurations, one-click run/stop with live output, task history and preview linking, persisted to .hba/run.json.

description_i18n.en: Run panel for HBA on ZCode: manage run configurations (command, working directory, env vars, preview URL), start/stop processes with live output streaming, review task history, and open the preview of a successful run.
description_i18n.zh-CN: HBA 运行面板：管理运行配置（启动命令、工作目录、环境变量、预览地址），一键运行/停止并实时查看输出，浏览任务历史，并在运行成功后打开预览。
